threads.body: This regression test exercises only synchronous non-streaming `generate_content`, but the changed flag controls four distinct call sites: sync/async and streaming/non-streaming. A mistake in any of the other three branches could still replace the caller's config unnoticed. Please cover all four as required by `.github/instructions/instrumentation.instructions.md#tests`; placing the pass-through assertion on the inherited `NonStreamingTestCase` would reuse the existing matrix across those paths.

it'd be extremely noisy if someone passes config we can't recognize - we'd write warning on every call.

Presumably SDK itself would complain loudly if it's really invalid.
